title: PLURALISTICBEHAVIORSUITE: Stress-Testing Multi-Turn Adherence to Custom Behavioral Policies
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (PBSUITE) for evaluating how well LLMs follow custom organizational and industry-specific behavioral policies across 30 business sectors. While it discusses 'pluralistic alignment' and includes 'cultural insensitivity' as one risk cluster, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems as a primary component of the work.
